title: Tie-dye home kit list and pattern planner
subject: Art & Design
source: Written for art/y8 lessons 14, 15, 16, 17 (Home kit: an old white cotton cloth or T-shirt, elastic bands, string, a tie-dye kit or natural dyes (turmeric, onion skins, red cabbage), gloves, a bowl, plastic sheet)
intro: Lesson 14: Tie-dye traditions and resist pattern. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

checklist: An old white cotton cloth or T-shirt
A tie-dye kit or natural dyes: turmeric, onion skins, red cabbage
A plastic sheet to cover the surface

keywords.def: colouring fabric that has been tied so some parts resist the dye
stopping dye reaching parts of the fabric

questions.q: Predict: a square cloth folded in a concertina and bound in three places.
Pupil PDF: design three tie-dye patterns on paper (fold diagram plus predicted result) inspired by one tradition.
Extend: research one tradition further and note two facts with a source.

options: resist the dye and stay pale
questions.a: A) resist the dye and stay pale. That's the resist.

questions.q: Think again: If you tie an elastic band tightly round cloth and dip it in dye, what happens under the band?
questions.a: The dye can't reach it, so a pale line or circle is left: that is resist.
